candidates.excerpt: const sessions = new Map(); export function createSession(userId, token) { sessions.set(token, { userId }); } export function currentUser(token) { return sessions.get(token)?.userId; }

export async function requestWithRetry(url) { for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 3; attempt++) { const response = await fetch(url); if (response.status !== 429) return response; await delay(1000); } throw new Error('Too many requests'); }
export async function enqueue(job) { const release = await mutex.acquire(); try { sharedQueue.push(job); } finally { release(); } }

export function checkout(items, taxRate) { const subtotal = items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.price * item.quantity, 0); const tax = subtotal * taxRate; return { subtotal, tax, total: subtotal + tax }; }
export async function migrate(db) { await db.exec('ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN verified BOOLEAN DEFAULT false'); }
